page.name: Material
page.label: "Experimental A:M surface preview. Connect a native A:M model, then a lighting node. Highlights use a preview shader; Hash render parity is not validated."
"Report Error identifies attributes the renderer cannot reproduce. Supported Attributes Preview omits those attributes. Procedural and plugin material trees are not yet supported."

page.name: Specular
page.label: "Enable Override Specular to key highlight size, intensity and color in OT3D. With no material file, the surface uses the level palette. Zero size or intensity disables shine."
"Shine follows each light and the camera. Ambient lighting adds no specular highlights. Scene reflections are deferred; file reflectivity settings are retained."
